map.plugin.title: Map
map.plugin.summary: The map page: AMap inside mainland China (enter an AMap key in Settings · Data sources), OpenStreetMap abroad and until a key is entered; OpenStreetMap tiles go through this computer, and this computer adds AMap's security code for the page. Finding places and routes: AMap inside mainland China, OpenStreetMap's free services abroad (no key; no transit or live traffic), and also inside China until an AMap key is entered
map.plugin.purge.keys: The AMap key and security code you entered
map.plugin.purge.tiles: Map tiles cached on this computer
map.plugin.keep.chat: Places mentioned in chats (that's chat history)
map.source.title: AMap
map.source.summary: With a key, the map page uses AMap inside mainland China, and looking up places and routes there uses it too (only when you ask, the start, the destination or the "nearby" spot goes to AMap; without a key, lookups in China also use OpenStreetMap, which may miss some shops and small roads). The key stays on this computer; where you went each day and where your photos were taken are never sent to AMap
map.source.disconnectNote: The key and security code are deleted from this computer; the map page uses OpenStreetMap inside China instead
map.configure.nothing: Enter the Web (JS API) key and its security code first
map.configure.pairNeeded: The Web key and the security code go together (both from the same key in the AMap console)
map.configure.badValue: Keys and security codes can't contain spaces or line breaks — check you didn't copy too much
map.configure.keptOld: The new one didn't pass ({reason}); still using the old one
map.plugin.purge.cards: Map cards in chats (their titles, places and routes)
map.card.text: Map card: {title} (open it to see the map)
map.drawing.gone: These places and routes have expired (they're only kept on this computer for a little while and never saved): ask again
map.error.key: AMap doesn't accept this key (mistyped, deleted, or expired)
map.error.securityCode: Wrong security code: enter the one generated together with this key
map.error.platformJs: This isn't a "Web (JS API)" key: when creating the key in the AMap console, choose Web (JS API) as the platform
map.error.platformService: This isn't a "Web service" key: create another key in the AMap console with Web service as the platform
map.error.ip: This key has an IP whitelist that doesn't include this computer: remove or change it in the AMap console
map.error.domain: This key is bound to domains that don't include ergo's address: remove the domain restriction in the AMap console
map.error.limit: AMap says the usage limit is reached ({info}): try again later
map.proxy.noKey: No AMap key and security code yet
map.plugin.purge.usage: The monthly counts of place and route lookups
map.lookup.problem.no_key: No Web service key yet: enter it above, test and save, then try again
map.lookup.problem.key: AMap doesn't accept this Web service key ({detail}): enter a new one
map.lookup.problem.denied: This key isn't allowed to use this service ({detail}): check which services it has in the AMap console
map.lookup.problem.quota: AMap says the usage limit is reached ({detail}): try again tomorrow, or check usage in the AMap console
map.lookup.problem.rate: Too many lookups, AMap asks to wait ({detail}): try again in a minute
map.lookup.problem.abroad: This place is outside mainland China, AMap can't look it up
map.lookup.problem.too_far: Too far apart for AMap to route ({detail})
map.lookup.problem.params: AMap says the lookup isn't written right ({detail})
map.lookup.problem.network: Can't reach AMap ({detail}): try again later
map.lookup.problem.server: Something went wrong on AMap's side ({detail}): try again later
map.try.scope: Test: search “{keyword}” in {city} (a fixed word, not your location)
map.try.ok: It works: place and route lookups are ready. Data from AMap, looked up just now, not saved
map.try.empty: Connected, but nothing was found this time. Data from AMap
map.try.usage: This month: place searches {search} / {searchLimit}, addresses and routes {lbs} / {lbsLimit} (AMap's free monthly quota for verified individuals; the AMap console has the real numbers)
map.doctor.usage.title: AMap usage
map.doctor.usage.noKey: No Web service key, so no place or route lookups
map.doctor.usage.ok: {month} so far: place searches {search} / {searchLimit}, addresses and routes {lbs} / {lbsLimit}
map.doctor.usage.near: {month} is close to the free quota for verified individuals: place searches {search} / {searchLimit}, addresses and routes {lbs} / {lbsLimit}
map.doctor.usage.over: {month} is over the free quota for verified individuals: place searches {search} / {searchLimit}, addresses and routes {lbs} / {lbsLimit}
map.doctor.usage.fixNear: Look up a bit less this month; check the real usage and quota in the AMap console
map.doctor.usage.fixOver: AMap may refuse or charge for the extra lookups: check the real usage and quota in the AMap console
